Layered Audio v0.19 processing-toolkit validation

Qualified executable paths:
- ooRexx object model/catalog/graph/streaming/placement regression.
- Foreign Runtime v0.22.5 ForeignPython reference provider.
- Native ForeignBuffer -> Python memoryview input path.
- Python NumPy processing output -> ForeignTensor runtime binding.
- ForeignTensor derived output -> second Python processor without byte materialisation.
- Maths v0.5 MathEvidence on correlation and alignment measurements.
- McGill stereo A-law external fixture channel-independence check.
- Historical Layered Audio core, transcript, fragment, pitch, speaker, music, scene, camera interop, FFmpeg decode, tensor and ASR preparation paths under v0.22.5.

McGill external fixture:
  format: G.711 A-law WAVE, stereo, 8 kHz
  samples/channel: 23493
  left RMS: ~0.02709204
  right RMS: ~0.02477716
  Pearson L/R correlation: ~0.00696814

Runtime Reference v0.4 TCP/JSON fallback requires an external `json.cls`; that dependency was not present in the supplied roll-up/environment, so the legacy TCP/JSON fallback is conditional in run_tests.sh and is not part of v0.19's new processing-provider qualification. Runtime Reference object/value semantics remain the offload envelope boundary.
